'''Insomnium''' is a Finnish [[melodic death metal]] band formed in [[Joensuu]] in 1997. Their sound and lyrics portray darkness, sorrow, loss, pain, and nature. Their music includes [[progressive metal]] and [[doom metal]].

== History ==
On 9 September 2011, Insomnium released the music video "Through the Shadows" from their 2011 album, ''[[One for Sorrow (album)|One for Sorrow]]''.<ref>{{cite web|title=New Video – Insomnium- Through The Shadows|url=http://www.metalcallout.com/metal-music-videos/new-video-insomnium-through-the-shadows.html|publisher=Metal CallOut|access-date=2011-09-09|archive-date=15 December 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141215032404/http://www.metalcallout.com/metal-music-videos/new-video-insomnium-through-the-shadows.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In November 2011, Insomnium headlined their first European tour with support from [[Before the Dawn (band)|Before the Dawn]] and [[MyGRAIN]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.insomnium.net/news/113/56/Album-release-dates-and-European-headline-tour|title=INSOMNIUM &#124; News|date=10 December 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111210194817/http://www.insomnium.net/news/113/56/Album-release-dates-and-European-headline-tour|access-date=9 October 2020|archive-date=10 December 2011}}</ref> During April 2012, Insomnium toured the U.K. as the main support act for British [[gothic metal]] band [[Paradise Lost (band)|Paradise Lost]]. Vreid was also on the tour as a supporting opening act.

On 19 September 2013, Insomnium released "Ephemeral", a single from their 2014 album, ''[[Shadows of the Dying Sun]]'', via [[Century Media Records]]. It was the first track to feature new guitarist Markus Vanhala ([[Omnium Gatherum]]), who replaced Ville Vänni in 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.blabbermouth.net/news/insomnium-new-song-ephemeral-released/ |title=Insomnium: New Song 'Ephemeral' Released |publisher=Blabbermouth.net |date=2013-09-19 |access-date=2015-08-19}}</ref>

On 29 April 2014, Insomnium released their sixth studio album, ''[[Shadows of the Dying Sun]]''. On 30 April 2014, they made a guest appearance on [[Epica (band)|Epica]]'s CD release show at [[013]] in the Netherlands.

On 19 May 2016, Insomnium announced their seventh studio album, ''[[Winter's Gate]]'', released on 23 September. It was a concept album, consisting of one 40-minute track, about "a group of Vikings who set out to find a fabled island west of Ireland, despite the treacherous winter drawing near."<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.blabbermouth.net/news/insomnium-to-release-winters-gate-album-book-in-september/|title=INSOMNIUM To Release 'Winter's Gate' Album, Book in September|publisher=Blabbermouth.net|date=19 May 2016|access-date=19 May 2016}}</ref> This album was based on the short story by Niilo, "Winter's Gate", or "Talven Portti" in the original Finnish. This story won or was nominated for many Finnish awards.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.blabbermouth.net/news/insomnium-to-release-winters-gate-album-book-in-september|title=Insomnium To Release 'Winter's Gate' Album, Book in September – Blabbermouth.net|date=19 May 2016}}</ref>

In 2019, they announced their eighth album, ''[[Heart Like a Grave]]'', released on 4 October 2019. With the album announcement, they confirmed that guitarist [[Jani Liimatainen]] had joined the band full time. He had occasionally filled in for Ville Friman on tours since 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://loudwire.com/insomnium-new-album-heart-like-a-grave/|title=Insomnium Announce New Album 'Heart Like a Grave'|first=Graham|last=Hartmann|website=Loudwire|date=16 July 2019 |access-date=2 November 2019}}</ref>

Insomnium released the EP ''Argent Moon'' on 17 September 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://metalstorm.net/events/news_comments.php?news_id=42724|title=Insomnium – Release 'The Antagonist' Song, Announce EP|publisher=[[Metal Storm (webzine)|Metal Storm]]|access-date=8 August 2021|date=17 July 2021}}</ref> They talked about plans for a ninth studio album to be released in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://metalstorm.net/events/news_comments.php?news_id=42944|title=Insomnium – To Release Ninth Studio Album Next Year|publisher=[[Metal Storm (webzine)|Metal Storm]]|access-date=8 August 2021|date=8 August 2021}}</ref> In 2022, they announced their ninth album, ''[[Anno 1696]]'', released on 24 February 2023. Like ''Winter's Gate'', the album is based on a short story by Niilo.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|author=Greg Kennelty|url=https://metalinjection.net/new-music/insomnium-streams-lilian-announces-new-record-anno-1696|title=INSOMNIUM Streams "Lilian," Announces New Record Anno 1696|publisher=Metal Injection|access-date=8 November 2022|date=4 November 2022}}</ref> In spring of 2023, the band toured with [[Enslaved (band)|Enslaved]] and [[Black Anvil]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-01-04 |title=The Rock + Metal Bands Touring in 2023 |url=https://loudwire.com/rock-metal-bands-touring-2023-guide/ |access-date=2026-03-02 |website=Loudwire |language=en}}</ref>

In March 2025, Niilo Sevänen confirmed that a tenth studio album by Insomnium was in the works and planned for a 2026 release.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://metalstorm.net/events/news_comments.php?news_id=57927|title=Insomnium - Working On New Material|publisher=[[Metal Storm (webzine)|Metal Storm]]|access-date=31 March 2025|date=31 March 2025}}</ref> The album name, ''Netherworlds'', and cover were revealed in July 2026. On 16 January 2026, touring guitarist Tomy Laisto was announced as an official member.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://lambgoat.com/news/51232/insomnium-welcomes-guitarist-tomy-laisto-as-an-official-member/|title=Insomnium welcomes guitarist Tomy Laisto as an official member|publisher=Lambgoat|access-date=16 January 2026|date=16 January 2026}}</ref>

== Members ==
=== Current members ===
* Niilo Sevänen – bass, [[Death growl|unclean vocals]] <small>(1997–present)</small>
* Ville Friman – guitars <small>(1997–present)</small>; [[Singing|clean vocals]] <small>(2011–present)</small>
* Markus Hirvonen – drums <small>(1997–present)</small>
* Markus Vanhala – guitars <small>(2011–present)</small>
* Tomy Laisto – guitars <small>(2026–present; touring 2024–2026)</small>

=== Former members ===
* Tapani Pesonen – guitars <small>(1997–1998)</small>; drums <small>(1997)</small>
* Timo Partanen – guitars <small>(1998–2001)</small>
* Ville Vänni – guitars <small>(2001–2011)</small>
* [[Jani Liimatainen]] – guitars, clean vocals <small>(2019–2024; touring 2015–2019)</small>

=== Touring members ===
* Tuomas Jäppinen – guitars <small>(2011)<ref>{{cite web |last1=Insomnium |title=Guitarist Ville Vänni Leaves Band |url=https://bravewords.com/news/insomnium-guitarist-ville-vanni-leaves-band/ |website=BraveWords |access-date=31 October 2011}}</ref></small>
* Mike Bear – vocals, bass <small>(2015)</small>
* Nick Cordle – guitars <small>(2022–2024)</small>
* Brandon Ellis – guitars <small>(2024)<ref>{{cite web |last1=Insomnium |title=Update on Jani Liimatainen |url=https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=935976187889924&set=pcb.935873797900163 |website=Facebook |access-date=16 February 2024}}</ref></small>
